linux-x64-ubuntu-22.04.rationale: Desktop shell internal payload baseline for Linux x64 Ubuntu 22.04: the 256 MiB application ceiling plus 64 MiB for the managed voice runtime inputs (a pinned uv executable of up to 48 MiB, the product wheel, the voice lock and its manifest, with headroom for uv updates)
